Flash: Blink a short distance in the aimed direction. The near-universal pick for repositioning, dodging skillshots, engaging or escaping.
Sprint: A burst of bonus movement speed, great for chasing or kiting on mobile carries.
Execute: Deal a chunk of true damage to a target - good for finishing tanks you can't fully burst.
Heal: Restore health to yourself and a nearby ally and gain a short speed boost.
Disrupt: Reduce a nearby enemy's damage output during the key fight window.
Purify: Cleanse crowd control from yourself and gain brief tenacity.
Smite: Deal heavy damage to monsters - the jungle clearing and objective tool.
Teleport: Teleport across the map to a chosen point after a short channel - used for rotations and split-push pressure.
Intimidate: Summon a guardian sentry that attacks nearby enemies for a few seconds.
Stun: Briefly stun a targeted enemy to lock them down.
Frenzy: Gain a burst of bonus attack speed for a short duration.
